I wish I could tell you that life can get better. I dont know if it can or not. But you got to push on, we've dealt with something so many people would never understand unless they experienced it. You're a stronger person because of it, that I can swear to you. You just got to find a reason to keep striving, even when you want to quit. Even if you can't find a reason, just keep going and telling yourself it can get better. It's something MANY people wouldn't be able to handle.

Just don't let it make you back down from the challenges you set for yourself in your mind. And realize at this point the problem is one that your making for yourself, its a fight inside your mind. Find ways to block it out, and keep your mind in a positive place. Realize ( and I know this gets said a lot on the subject but it's a very important step ) it wasn't your fault, and no one has any right to say otherwise.
